title: A running push or sync keeps its write lease when tracy-web restarts while the host does not answer
steps: Start a preview (and a sync), age the lease past 90 s, read the rows back with every host job request failing.
expect: The lease is renewed and still the push/sync; a chat takeWriteLease is refused; once the host answers and the job ended, the lease goes.

tests: a push read back while the host does not answer keeps its lease
a sync read back while the host does not answer keeps its lease
